words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: We eat supper at six o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们六点吃晚饭。
words.en: Supper is the last meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.tr: adv. 深深地；深刻地；非常；
words.ex: She was deeply moved by the story.
words.ex_cn: 她被这个故事深深打动了。
words.en: To a great depth; profoundly.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: He used a stopwatch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A stopwatch is a watch that can be started and stopped by pressing a button, used for timing events accurately.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.ex: He eats mutton for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃羊肉当晚餐。
words.en: Mutton is the meat of an adult sheep eaten as food.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr: adv. 快乐地；幸福地；幸运地；
words.ex: She smiled happily when she got the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她收到礼物时快乐地笑了。
words.en: In a happy manner; with happiness.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: He is an unmarried man who lives alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个独居的未婚男子。
words.en: Not married; single.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: The old bridge is unsafe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥过桥不安全。
words.en: If a place, situation, or activity is unsafe, it is dangerous.

words.ex: He was unsuccessful in finding a job.
words.ex_cn: 他找工作没有成功。
words.en: Not achieving the desired results; not successful.

words.ex: The story he told was untrue.
words.ex_cn: 他讲的故事是不真实的。
words.en: If a statement or idea is untrue, it is false and not based on facts.

words.ex: He lifted a ton of bricks yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天搬了一吨砖。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds in Britain and 2,000 pounds in the United States. It is also used informally to mean a large amount of something.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He put vinegar on his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他把醋倒在沙拉上。
words.en: A sour-tasting liquid used as a condiment or preservative, typically made by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine, cider, or beer.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: Fifty percent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: A percent is a unit of measure equal to one hundredth of a whole. It is often used to express proportions, rates, and comparisons in various contexts, such as finance, statistics, and everyday calculations.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: She ate delicious Mexican food at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 她在餐厅吃了美味的墨西哥食物。
words.en: Relating to Mexico or its people.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.tr: n. 中小学的校长；中小学班主任
words.ex: The headteacher speaks to the students every morning.
words.ex_cn: 校长每天早上对学生讲话。
words.en: The principal or head of a school.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: The politician gave a speech about education.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家就教育问题发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A politician is a person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of or a candidate for an elected office.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: The first century had no computers.
words.ex_cn: 第一个世纪没有电脑。
words.en: A century is a period of one hundred years.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果。
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.tr: n. 炸马铃薯条；碎片( chip的名词复数；
words.ex: I would like some chips with my burger.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一些炸薯条配我的汉堡。
words.en: Chips are thin slices of potato that are fried until they are hard and crunchy and are usually eaten cold as a snack.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，不喜欢做作业。
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.tr:
n. 东北；
adj. 东北的；
words.ex: The storm came from the northeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东北方向。
words.en: The northeast is the direction which is halfway between north and east. It is also the area that lies in this direction.

words.ex: The birds fly northwards in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天，鸟儿向北飞。
words.en: Towards the north.

words.tr:
n. 西北；
adj. 西北的；
words.ex: The storm is moving from the northwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴正从西北方向移动。
words.en: The northwest is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: The ship sailed through the strait at night.
words.ex_cn: 船在夜间通过了海峡。
words.en: A strait is a narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.tr:
adj. 亚洲的；
n. 亚洲人；
words.ex: He eats asian food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃亚洲食物。
words.en: relating to Asia or its people, customs, or languages

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: The shop assistant helped me find the shoes.
words.ex_cn: 店员帮我找到了鞋子。
words.en: A shop assistant is a person whose job is to serve customers in a shop.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: The tomatoes grow in a glasshouse.
words.ex_cn: 番茄在温室里生长。
words.en: A glasshouse is a building with glass sides and a glass roof, in which plants that need protection from cold weather are grown.

words.ex: She put flowers in a vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把花放在桌子上的花瓶里。
words.en: A vase is a container, often used for holding cut flowers. It can be made from a variety of materials, including glass, ceramics, and metals.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.tr: n. 乘务员；管家；保护者
words.ex: The steward served drinks on the plane.
words.ex_cn: 空乘人员在飞机上提供饮料。
words.en: A steward is a person whose job is to look after the passengers on a ship, aircraft, or train and bring them meals. A steward is also a person who is in charge of the organization of a particular event, or who manages someone else's property.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: She licked her lip before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 她在说话前舔了舔嘴唇。
words.en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

words.ex: He took a mouthful of soup.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一口汤。
words.en: A mouthful is an amount of food or drink that you put into your mouth at one time.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的看法。
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He returned to his homeland after many years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他回到了祖国。
words.en: Your homeland is your native country.

words.ex: He returned to his hometown after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后回到了家乡。
words.en: Your hometown is the town or city where you were born or grew up.

words.tr: adj. 诚实的；正直的；坦率的；
words.ex: He gave an honest answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师给出了一个诚实的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as honest, you mean that they always tell the truth, and do not try to deceive people or break the law.

words.tr: adj. 通常的；寻常的；惯常的；
words.ex: He takes the usual bus to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通常坐这路公交车去上班。
words.en: If something is usual, it happens most often or was most often the case in the past.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.tr:
n. 穆斯林；伊斯兰教信徒
adj. 穆斯林的；伊斯兰教的
words.ex: He is a moslem who prays five times a day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天祈祷五次的穆斯林。
words.en: A Moslem is a follower of the religion of Islam.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.ex: He will possibly come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天可能会来。
words.en: You use possibly to indicate that something is true or might be true, but you are not certain.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: It is probable that he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天来的可能性很大。
words.en: If you say that something is probable, you mean that it is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.tr: n. 交会处；十字路口； v. 穿过；“cross”的现在分词；
words.ex: Be careful at the crossing near the school.
words.ex_cn: 在学校附近的交会处要小心。
words.en: A crossing is a place where something such as a road, river, or railway can be crossed safely.

words.ex: He stopped at the crossroads to decide which way to go.
words.ex_cn: 他在十字路口停下来，决定走哪条路。
words.en: A crossroads is a place where two roads cross each other. It can also refer to a point in time when a crucial decision must be made that will have far-reaching consequences.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr:
v. 逼迫；推；
n. 推；奋力；
words.ex: The teacher pushed the student to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师逼迫学生完成作业。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: He went to the pub after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.tr: adj. 惯用左手的；用左手的
words.ex: He is left-handed and writes with his left hand.
words.ex_cn: 他是左撇子，用左手写字。
words.en: Someone who is left-handed uses their left hand rather than their right hand for activities such as writing and sports and for handling tools and objects.

words.ex: He supports left-wing policies.
words.ex_cn: 他支持左翼政策。
words.en: The left-wing of a political party or system is the section of it that consists of socialists.

words.ex: He bought a secondhand bike for $50.
words.ex_cn: 他花50美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: Something that is secondhand is not new and has been owned by someone else before.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.tr: adj. （感到）高兴的；愉快的；满意的； v. “please”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She was pleased with her test score.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己的考试成绩感到高兴。
words.en: If you are pleased, you are happy or satisfied about something.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: He put the bread in the pan.
words.ex_cn: 他把面包放进平底锅里。
words.en: A pan is a round metal container with a long handle, which is used for cooking things in, usually on top of a stove.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.tr:
adj. 最坏的；最糟糕的；
n. 最坏的事；
words.ex: This is the worst day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 这是我生命中最糟糕的一天。
words.en: Superlative of bad: of the lowest quality, or the most unpleasant, difficult, or severe

words.ex: There is plenty of food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有充足的食物。
words.en: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough.

words.tr: n. 西藏（现一般使用 Xizang）
words.ex: He visited Tibet last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了西藏。
words.en: A region in central Asia, known for its high altitude and unique culture, located on the Tibetan Plateau.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.tr: adj. 中秋的; n. 中秋
words.ex: We ate mooncakes during the mid-autumn festival.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中秋节期间吃了月饼。
words.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival, also known as the Moon Festival, is a harvest festival celebrated by ethnic Chinese and Vietnamese people.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.tr: phrase. 中东（通常指西亚和北非部分地区）
words.ex: The middle east has many deserts and ancient cities.
words.ex_cn: 中东有许多沙漠和古城。
words.en: The Middle East is a region that encompasses Western Asia and all of or part of Northern Africa, depending on the context.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.tr:
n. 笑话；玩笑；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: He told a funny joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上讲了一个有趣的笑话。
words.en: A joke is something that is said or done to make people laugh, especially a funny story or a trick played on someone.

words.tr:
n. 叉子；分岔；分支
v. 分岔；用叉子叉
words.ex: He picked up a fork to eat his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起叉子吃意大利面。
words.en: A fork is a tool used for eating or serving food, consisting of a handle with several narrow tines on one end. It can also refer to a division into two or more branches or directions.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.tr:
adv. 向上地；
adj. 向上的；
words.ex: The balloon moved upward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 气球缓慢地向上移动。
words.en: Moving or directed toward a higher place or level.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.ex: The heroine saves the town from the dragon.
words.ex_cn: 女主角拯救了小镇免受龙的侵害。
words.en: A heroine is a woman who is admired for her courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities, especially a woman who has performed a heroic act or is the main character in a story.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.ex: He ate a ripe peach for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的桃子。
words.en: A peach is a soft, round, slightly furry fruit with sweet yellow flesh and pinky-orange skin. Peaches grow in warm countries.

words.ex: She ate a ripe pear for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个熟透的梨当零食。
words.en: A pear is a sweet, juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom. It has a thin green or brown skin, and white flesh.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠带着一颗坚果跑上了树。
words.en: A squirrel is a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees and is known for its ability to climb and jump.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: She pulled up the bedclothes to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上被褥保暖。
words.en: The sheets, blankets, and other coverings used on a bed.

words.tr: n. 床上用品；寝具； v. “bed”的现在分词；
words.ex: She bought new bedding for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床上用品。
words.en: Bedding refers to the materials that are used on a bed for sleeping on, such as sheets and blankets.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: The answer is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是不正确的。
words.en: If something is incorrect, it is not accurate or true.

words.ex: He has a black moustache.
words.ex_cn: 他有一撮黑色的胡子。
words.en: A moustache is the hair that grows on a man's upper lip.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: This village is the birthplace of the famous poet.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是这位著名诗人的发源地。
words.en: The place where someone was born.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr:
n. 大头针；
v. 固定；
words.ex: She stuck a pin on the map.
words.ex_cn: 她在地图上别了一枚大头针。
words.en: A pin is a small piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening pieces of cloth together.

words.ex: He poured sauce on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他把酱汁倒在意大利面上。
words.en: A sauce is a thick liquid which is served with other food.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: He ate a sausage for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一根香肠。
words.en: A sausage is a type of meat product usually made from ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, along with salt, spices, and other flavorings. Other ingredients such as grains or breadcrumbs may be included as fillers or extenders.

words.ex: He turned onto the sideroad to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他拐进辅路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A sideroad is a small road that branches off from a main road.

words.ex: He walked down the sideway to avoid the main road.
words.ex_cn: 他走小路以避开主路。
words.en: A sideway is a path or road that is at the side of a main road or that leads away from a main road.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: He put on a blue necktie for the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他为面试戴了一条蓝色领带。
words.en: A necktie is a long piece of cloth that is worn around the neck, usually by men, and is tied in a knot at the front. Neckties are often worn as part of formal or business attire.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: He put the clothes in the washing-machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other fabrics.

words.ex: He went to the washroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A room with facilities for washing and usually also toilet facilities; a bathroom.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: He eats a grape every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗葡萄。
words.en: A grape is a small, round fruit that grows in bunches on a vine. Grapes can be green, red, or purple and are used for making wine, eating fresh, or drying into raisins.

words.tr: abbr. 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺乏综合症；“Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome”的缩写；
words.ex: He got tested for aids last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了艾滋病检测。
words.en: AIDS is a disease caused by a virus that weakens a person's immune system, making them vulnerable to other infections and diseases.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: This book is a best-seller in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在许多国家都是畅销书。
words.en: A best-seller is a book or other product that sells in very large numbers.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: The horse eats hay every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马每天早上吃干草。
words.en: Hay is grass which has been cut and dried so that it can be used to feed animals.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 我们为圣诞节买礼物。
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.tr:
n. 基督教徒；
adj. 基督教的；
words.ex: He is a christian who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的基督教徒。
words.en: A Christian is a person who believes in Jesus Christ and follows his teachings.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: The brewery makes fresh beer every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家啤酒厂每天生产新鲜的啤酒。
words.en: A brewery is a place where beer is made commercially.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: The child ate a piece of candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后吃了一块糖果。
words.en: Candy is a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate, often eaten as a treat.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: The cat used its claw to scratch the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫用爪子抓树。
words.en: A claw is a curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals. As a verb, it means to scratch, tear, or pull with claws or fingernails.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 绿叶从树上落了下来。
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.ex: He kick the ball into the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他把球踢进了球门。
words.en: To strike or propel with the foot; a blow or thrust delivered by the foot.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.tr: v. 转；转动；转弯；“turn”的现在分词； n. 转弯处；拐弯处；岔路口；
words.ex: He is turning the key to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正在转动钥匙开门。
words.en: A turning is a place where a road branches off another road.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.
